holdout_download_policy: no download until selection lock; one frozen evaluation, all findings retained; short retrospective holdout cannot establish long-term alpha
development_status: all data through 2025 exploratory; selection scores are not independent confirmations
universe: same frozen 87 tradable names and 88-name development rank reference; no future-conditioned substitutions
model_selection: fixed parameters; no new tree search; residual labels cross-sectionally regress training future returns on contemporaneously known factor proxies
risk: long-only; max 95% invested; 10% annualized ex ante volatility target using trailing 60-session close-return covariance with 25% diagonal shrinkage; no leverage; rebalance every20 sessions
incremental_constraint: residual-tilt optimization fixes momentum, medium momentum, volatility and reversal proxy exposure to contemporaneous optimized momentum reference before common volatility scaling
selection: highest mean daily active-return information ratio across two development folds vs same-risk momentum; eligible only if positive active mean in both folds and mean Sharpe exceeds momentum with no worse worst-fold drawdown; otherwise exploratory candidate only
inference: paired whole-date circular block bootstrap 20 and60 sessions; HAC factor-proxy regression lag20; report uncertainty against momentum and best traditional comparator selected on development only
